## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (typecheck, lint, format, tests)
- [ ] New behaviour is covered by tests
- [ ] Docs updated (README / `docs/`) if user-facing behaviour changed
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies (or justified in the description)
- [ ] Considered ZIP edge cases (ZIP64, data descriptors, STORED vs DEFLATE) where relevant
